How to make AI replies sound like you, not a robot

Ask AI to "reply to a booking" and you get "We are pleased to confirm your appointment." Nobody talks like that.

The fix is 3 words, plus one example:

"Reply to [WHO + WHAT THEY ASKED]. Sound like me. Here's a message I sent last week: [PASTE ONE OF YOUR MESSAGES]"

AI copies what it sees. Give it nothing and you get its default voice. Give it one of your messages and it picks up your greeting, your sentence length and your warmth.

Tip: keep your best message in your notes app and paste it every time.

Send this to someone who still rewrites every AI reply by hand. Follow @nomorebusywork for one fix a day.
